commerce: Implement a reliable e-commerce checkout workflow across models.py, inventory.py, pricing.py, payments.py, audit.py, and orders.py. Preserve existing public class names and method signatures. All monetary amounts are integer cents. LineItem(sku, quantity) and Receipt(order_id, total, status) are immutable dataclasses. Inventory.reserve(items) must atomically decrement stock after aggregating duplicate SKUs; reject empty items, unknown SKUs, invalid quantities (including bool), and insufficient stock with ValueError, without mutation on failure. Pricing.calculate(items, coupon=None) must aggregate duplicate SKUs, validate inputs and known prices, and calculate subtotal in integer cents. The discounts mapping associates coupon codes with integer percentage discounts from 0 through 100; unknown coupons and invalid discount values raise ValueError. Apply discounts using integer floor division. Payments.charge(order_id, amount, approved=True) must reject invalid IDs and nonpositive or noninteger amounts, raise ValueError for declined payments, and never charge the same order twice; repeat identical successful charges return the original amount, conflicting amounts raise ValueError. AuditLog.record(order_id, total) must record a successful order exactly once; identical repeats are idempotent, conflicting repeats raise ValueError. OrderService.checkout(order_id, items, coupon=None, approved=True) must validate and price the order, check stock, process payment, reserve inventory, record the audit event, and return Receipt(order_id, total, 'paid'). Repeating an existing successful order_id must return the original receipt without additional charges, inventory changes, or audit events. Invalid input, insufficient stock, or declined payment must leave inventory, charges, orders, and audit events unchanged. A successful checkout must coordinate all six modules. Do not modify test files. Transaction rollback requirement: if any operation raises an exception during checkout, restore the pre-checkout state of inventory.stock, payments.charges, audit.events, and OrderService.orders. This includes exceptions raised after inventory reservation or audit recording has partially mutated state. Propagate the original exception. A subsequent retry with the same order ID must be able to succeed.
